regular.title: CARAMEL RÊVE
regular.description: Nothing planned until sunset. A caramel knit dress, a matching sun hat, and delicate pearl details. She settles into a garden chair, sipping iced tea and watching the trees sway. Lunch runs late. The afternoon drifts by. For once, there’s no feeling she should be doing something else. *Outfit is securely attached to OFFY and is not removable.
